summary: End-to-end verification against LIVE production API https://api.neksathi.in — ALL 6 requested user flows PASS. (1) demo@neksathi.app/demo1234 login succeeds and lands on Security tab. (2) Smart QR → Vehicles → 'Add vehicle' modal creates a new vehicle (TEST6421 → POST /api/vehicles → 200) and it appears both in the app list and in GET /api/vehicles. (3) Direct navigation to /scan-report?qrId=9a85011b-... resolves MH14DEMO01, renders reason chips (scan-reason-wrong_parking et al.), 'Call owner' (scan-vehicle-call) and 'Send notification' (scan-vehicle-notify). Tapping Send notification calls POST /api/public/qr/{qr}/incident → 200 and shows the 'Thank you!' screen with '~15 minutes' copy. Public tag /alert and card /message endpoints also confirmed alive via API (see notes). (4) POST /api/public/qr/9a85011b-.../call/start (unauthenticated) → within ~5s the responsive incoming-call overlay (testID 'incoming-call-overlay') shows 'Someone needs to reach you about vehicle MH14DEMO01' with call-decline/call-accept; call-decline dismisses the overlay (POST /api/me/calls/{id}/reject fires). (5) POST /api/public/qr/9a85011b-.../incident {type:'wrong_parking'} → within ~2s the '🔔 New wrong parking on MH14DEMO01' toast appears (screenshot captured). (6) Smart-QR detail 'Copy scan link' places https://neksathi.in/scan/9a85011b-7c38-4105-932b-0f8e2a50df64 in clipboard — QR encodes the neksathi.in web-portal URL, NOT api.neksathi.in. Backend pytest run: 15/26 tests pass; 11 failures are legacy test-schema mismatches (production API returns different keys — see 'backend_issues.minor') and are NOT app-side regressions.

minor.issue: Returns {service, status:'ok'} instead of {ok:true}. Legacy test expects 'ok' key. App does not depend on this.
Production response omits 'kind' discriminator; still returns full vehicle payload. Client detects kind via which resolver (qr/tag/card) succeeded, so no functional impact.
Tag QR resolves through /api/public/tag/{qr} only (not /api/public/qr/{qr}); production returns 404 for tags on the vehicle endpoint. App already tries qr → tag → card in scan-report.tsx so it works.
Response missing 'in_family' key that legacy test asserts. Not blocking any tested user flow.
Not deployed on api.neksathi.in (404). App uses the neksathi.in/scan/{qr} web portal instead, which is the intended architecture.
Legacy test posts {name,phone,message} → 422. App correctly posts {from_name, phone, body} via endpoints.ts, which succeeds.

react_native_issues.issue: Cosmetic web-preview warnings only: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported, falling back to JS' and 'shadow*/pointerEvents deprecated'. No functional impact on native build. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/LiveOverlays.tsx:87,90

action_items: Optional: update /app/backend/tests/test_neksathi_api.py assertions to match production api.neksathi.in schema (or gate legacy /api/s/... and 'kind' assertions with an env flag) — currently 11 pre-existing test-schema failures pollute the run.
Optional: gate LiveOverlays useNativeDriver behind Platform.OS !== 'web' to silence RCTAnimation warning in web preview.
critical_code_review_comments: scan-report.tsx correctly falls back qr → tag → card resolvers, so the missing 'kind' key on production /public/qr responses is handled.
endpoints.ts messageCard() correctly maps client {name, phone, message} → server {from_name, phone, body}, matching production schema.
scanUrl() in endpoints.ts uses EXPO_PUBLIC_WEB_URL (https://neksathi.in) — confirmed encoded in generated QR.

success_rate.backend: 58% raw pytest (15/26) — 100% of endpoints exercised by the app work correctly; failures are test-side schema drift
